The day of the Mile Championship. Amid the 
rising anticipation of the spectators... 
Ikuno Dictus felt a deep sense of 
fulfillment.

With thorough maintenance and management, 
her condition is flawless. What's more, 
she mastered a running style leveraging 
her experience in the previous race.

And this upcoming race would be a 
culmination of her own growth— or so Ikuno 
Dictus stated.

Her rivals: Daitaku Helios, Yamanin 
Zephyr, and Nice Nature. The curtains rise 
on the Mile Championship!
